test_title: PYST 56: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 13th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six girls (A, B, C, D, E and F) are sitting around a circular table. All of them are facing towards the centre of the circle. Not E, but someone else from the group is sitting between B and D. A is sitting to the left of F. C is fourth to the right of A. Who is sitting second to the left of A?
solution:
Six girls (**A, B, C, D, E and F**) are sitting around a circular table. All of them are facing towards the centre of the circle. 

1. C is fourth to the right of A.

2. A is sitting to the left of F.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a1c51a07b7378e408120adf1f7f9d5138d36e8e797fe84c431dd01e59308d35.png] 

3. Not E, but someone else from the group is sitting between B and D. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab286ee6d94e9249b24ed51bcb661309acf304a471e6c019be56ddb8125040a2.png] 

As only one position is vacant, it will be occupied by E, the the only person left.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2669c24825c18e81f3b60cfc7e8a717985b1fc36a3a660ff0fa0eed0499df5df.png] 

Clearly, C is sitting second to the left of A.

Hence, '**C**' is the correct answer.
